lines.en: Silently glides over the ground
Dark shadow moves quickly
Creeping dark silhouette
Slithers slowly in the shadows
As silent as the night
Lightly swaying in darkness
Passes like a ghost
Moves slowly in the shadows
Moves quietly in the dark
Moves silently in the shadows
Sliding along the wall's edge.
My shadow arrives a step ahead of me.

lines.zh: 第二个我，站得更近一点。
lines.en: The second me stands a little closer.
Dark shadow stills
Stands still in the dark
Silently waiting in the dark
Waiting silently
Silent shadow stands
Stills in the shadows
Remains motionless in the night
Stands in silence
Dark shadow stands still
Counting the beats of your heart.
Waiting in the corner for you to look back.
The smell of your pills pushes me back.
The dandelion dims another notch.

lines.zh: 我弓着背，眼睛藏在褶子里。
lines.en: I hunch; my eyes hide in the folds.
Gazing at you

lines.zh: 我的触须先指向你的喉咙。
lines.en: My tendrils point at your throat first.

lines.zh: 影子仆从听得见你吸气。
lines.en: A shadow henchman hears you inhale.

lines.zh: 你的每个抬手，我都记下。
lines.en: I note each raise of your hand.
Trailing your shadow

lines.zh: 注视着你的每一次呼吸
lines.en: Watching your breaths

lines.zh: 第二个影子，比你多一步。
lines.en: The second shadow is one step ahead of you.
Gazing at your presence
I watch you from inside your memories.
Your fear puts me back together.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我贴在你背后。
lines.en: When you turn, I am against your back.
Do you recognize this face?

lines.zh: 我把你的噩梦穿在身上
lines.en: I wear your nightmare like a coat.
The thing in the mirror is not me.
Your sanity is cracking.
I close in on you one step at a time.
You cannot count my fingers.
I saw the thing you buried.
In the dark I am closest to you.
Shadows twist around you.
Your shadow mocks you.
Shadow minions close in.
Darkness consumes your flesh.
Infinite fear grips you.
Shadows wrap around you.
You float in the void.
Shadows loom behind you.
Terror reigns here.

lines.zh: 黑雾从伤口里漏出去了。
lines.en: Black mist leaks from the wound.

lines.zh: 腐朽的心跳动着黑暗的渴望。
lines.en: A dark hunger pulses in the decaying heart.

lines.zh: 影子仆从2的触须蠕动着。
lines.en: Its shadow tendrils wriggle.

lines.zh: 它的皮下血管闪烁着幽光。
lines.en: Its subcutaneous vessels glow with a faint light.
Suck the flesh, nourish the darkness.
Its black eyes stare at you.
It moves slowly from the shadows.

lines.zh: 影子仆从2的触须摸索着。
lines.en: Its shadow tendrils feel about.
It laps at nearby carrion.
Its whispers are filled with greed.

lines.zh: 影子仆从2的喉咙发出咕噜声。
lines.en: Its throat makes a growling sound.
The Shadow Henchman 2 collides with the ground.
Its tendrils tangle together.

lines.zh: 影子仆从2的影子模糊不清。
lines.en: The Shadow Henchman 2's shadow is indistinct.
It suddenly appears from the darkness.
The Shadow Henchman 2's shadow inflates.

lines.zh: 它的影子与你的影子交织。
lines.en: Its shadow intertwines with yours.

lines.zh: 它在空气中留下模糊的轮廓。
lines.en: It leaves a faint outline in the air.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠绕在你的身上。
lines.en: Its tendrils wrap around you.
The Shadow Henchman 2's shadow distorts.

lines.zh: 它的影子似乎与你融为一体。
lines.en: Its shadow seems to merge with you.

lines.zh: 两团黑影并在一起，算同类。
lines.en: Two black shapes merge: kin at last.

lines.zh: 影子仆从2发出求偶的叫声。
lines.en: The Shadow Henchman 2 makes a mating call.
A tendril coils around another shadow.
Its whispers are filled with lust.

lines.zh: 影子仆从2的影子扭曲缠绕。
lines.en: The Shadow Henchman 2's shadow twists and intertwines.

lines.zh: 它的触须相互缠绕，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Its tendrils intertwine, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 它的影子寻找着潜在的伴侣。
lines.en: Its shadow searches for a potential mate.

lines.zh: 它试图与影子仆从2接合。
lines.en: It attempts to fuse with a Shadow Henchman 2.

lines.zh: 影子仆从2的触须互相触碰。
lines.en: Its tendrils touch each other.

lines.zh: 它的影子在空中形成亲密的图案。
lines.en: Its shadow forms intimate patterns in the air.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，它蜷缩成一团，感受着周围微弱的光线。
lines.en: Sssss, it curls up, sensing the faint light around.

lines.zh: 它轻轻蠕动，寻找着可能的食物来源。
lines.en: It crawls gently, seeking a food source.

lines.zh: 漆黑中，它的眼睛反射出微弱的绿光。
lines.en: In the darkness, its eyes glow faintly green.

lines.zh: 它舔了舔嘴唇，寻找着可以吞咽的东西。
lines.en: It licks its lips, searching for something to eat.

lines.zh: 它缓缓移动，寻找着新的藏身之处。
lines.en: It moves slowly, seeking a new hiding spot.

lines.zh: 它蜷缩成一团，似乎在等待什么。
lines.en: It curls up, waiting for something.

lines.zh: 它的触手轻轻触碰，试探着空气中的气味。
lines.en: Its tentacles touch the air, sensing scents.

lines.zh: 它缓缓移动，试图找到新的猎物。
lines.en: It moves slowly, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着期待的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with anticipation.

lines.zh: 它蜷缩着，等待着夜晚的到来。
lines.en: It curls up, waiting for night to fall.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛突然放光，锁定了一个目标。
lines.en: Its eyes glow suddenly, locking onto a target.

lines.zh: 它缓缓移动，追踪着猎物的气味。
lines.en: It moves slowly, tracking the prey's scent.

lines.zh: 它伸出触手，试图抓住目标。
lines.en: It extends its tentacles, trying to grab the target.

lines.zh: 它张开嘴，发出低沉的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It opens its mouth, making a low hiss.

lines.zh: 第二形态的影子，贴着你。
lines.en: Second-form shadow, pressed to you.

lines.zh: 它缓缓逼近，目标近在咫尺。
lines.en: It slowly approaches, the target close.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛中闪烁着凶光，准备攻击。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with aggression, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它张开触手，试图抓住猎物。
lines.en: It opens its tentacles, trying to grab the prey.

lines.zh: 它突然加速，向目标扑去。
lines.en: It suddenly accelerates, lunging at the target.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛紧盯着，不放过任何一个机会。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on the target, not missing any opportunity.
The smell of an old wound pulls me over.
Your shadow betrayed you first.
I have known you for a long time.

lines.zh: 这具身体终于有了实形
lines.en: This body finally has real shape.
Fleeing into the light will not help.
I follow the trail of your fear.

lines.zh: 它用触手紧紧缠住目标。
lines.en: It wraps its tentacles tightly around the target.

lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，警告其他生物远离。
lines.en: It makes a hiss, warning other creatures to stay away.

lines.zh: 它用触手缠住目标，准备吞噬。
lines.en: It wraps its tentacles around the target, ready to devour.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着目标，准备攻击。
lines.en: Its eyes focus on the target, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它用触手紧抓住目标，不让其逃脱。
lines.en: It tightly grabs the target with its tentacles.

lines.zh: 它缓缓逼近目标，准备捕食。
lines.en: It slowly approaches the target, ready to feed.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛锁定目标，准备捕食。
lines.en: Its eyes lock onto the target, ready to feed.

lines.zh: 它用触手牢牢抓住目标，不让其逃脱。
lines.en: It tightly holds the target with its tentacles.
It focuses on the target, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，警告其他生物不要靠近。
lines.en: It makes a hiss, warning other creatures not to get close.

lines.zh: 我的手指伸进你的影子
lines.en: My fingers sink into your shadow.
Each step I take makes you colder.
You are gripping that pill bottle too hard.
I mimic the way you speak.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了我的节奏
lines.en: Your breathing breaks my rhythm.
An extra shadow appears on the wall.

lines.zh: 我让你听见自己的名字
lines.en: I make you hear your own name.
The dark has sealed your way out.
I breathe against the back of your neck.
The more afraid you are, the sharper I am.
A shadow flickers in the dark!
The shadow swipes with its claws!

lines.zh: 尖锐的嘶嘶声划破夜空！
lines.en: A sharp hiss pierces the night!

lines.zh: 它的眼睛仿佛能看到暗处！
lines.en: Its eyes can see in the dark!

lines.zh: 黑色的触手缠绕在你身上！
lines.en: Black tentacles wrap around you!

lines.zh: 影子仆从的咬合力惊人！
lines.en: The shadow's bite is powerful!

lines.zh: 它的影子化为实体攻击！
lines.en: Its shadow becomes实体攻击!

lines.zh: 黑暗中传来低沉的咆哮！
lines.en: A deep growl rumbles in the dark!

lines.zh: 影子仆从的爪子撕裂空气！
lines.en: Its claws tear through the air!

lines.zh: 黑暗中的邪恶触手攻击！
lines.en: Evil tentacles attack from the darkness!
A hand from the shadow grabs you.
Your past lands a punch on you.
I squeeze the throat of your memory.
A cold blade cuts through the dark.
I tear off your last shred of sanity.

lines.zh: 这一击来自你最怕的地方
lines.en: This blow comes from where you fear most.

lines.zh: 腐朽的树枝上落下黑影！
lines.en: A shadow drops from rotten branches!

lines.zh: 黑暗森林中出现影子仆从！
lines.en: A shadow chieftain appears in the dark forest!

lines.zh: 腐烂的地面上冒出黑影！
lines.en: A shadow pops out of the rotten ground!

lines.zh: 影子仆从的蛋孵化成幼体！
lines.en: A shadow chieftain egg hatches into a幼体!

lines.zh: 黑暗中传来诡异的叫声！
lines.en: Strange cries echo in the dark!

lines.zh: 影子仆从从石缝中钻出！
lines.en: A shadow chieftain crawls out of a crack!

lines.zh: 腐烂的泥土中涌出黑影！
lines.en: Black shadows surge from rotten soil!

lines.zh: 影子仆从在黑暗中徘徊！
lines.en: A shadow chieftain wanders in the dark!
A shadow chieftain emerges from rotting wood!

lines.zh: 腐朽的石块上落下黑影！
lines.en: A shadow drops from a rotten stone!
In the instant the pills wear off.
A second figure appears in the mirror.

lines.zh: 蒲公英彻底枯萎的时候
lines.en: When the dandelion finally withers.
You hear footsteps in your sleep.
A hand reaches out from under the bed.
The light at the corridor's end dies.
It steps out of an old photograph.
The shadow stands up on its own.
Black seeps out of the crack in the wall.

lines.zh: 你回头的那一刻我诞生
lines.en: I am born the moment you look back.

lines.zh: 火咬住我的褶边，冒出焦味。
lines.en: Fire bites my fringes; they smell scorched.
You fell into the Shadow Abyss.
Shadows choke your breath.
Explosion rips through your shadow.
Arrow pierces your shadow.
Magic freezes your form.
Starvation weakens your will.
Lightning strikes your shadow.
Void tears through your being.
